subject: MedBridge - SCIM lifecycle, service-account lineage, and SAML assertion samples
messages:
From: Tim Rosen <tim.rosen@medbridge.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Security Team <security@medbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SCIM lifecycle + service-account lineage for SOC2 pack

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. MedBridge's SOC 2 auditor has asked for a concise package covering:

- SCIM lifecycle deltas for the last 90 days (add/modify/deprovision event rows)
- SAML assertion samples for interactive and API login flows (redacted PII ok)
- A service-account lineage matrix that maps service accounts to owners and delegated roles

Can you confirm what you can deliver by Friday (2026-10-09)? Auditor asked for files + a short explanation of any gaps (eg. shadow accounts, manual provision exceptions).

Appreciate a single ZIP or Drive link.

Best,
Tim Rosen
Director of Security Programs
MedBridge Health

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Tim Rosen <tim.rosen@medbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SCIM lifecycle + service-account lineage for SOC2 pack

Tim — thanks for the clear ask. We can put together the dataset and a short narrative. Quick notes before we assemble:

- SCIM deltas: we can export a CSV of user/entitlement deltas with timestamps, actor (SCIM token / admin id), and reason tag. We will include a delta flag for provisioning origin (SCIM sync / manual UI / API).
- SAML assertions: we'll provide 6 anonymized assertion samples (interactive login, SSO from Okta, and SAML-based backfill flows). We'll redact subject identifiers and include the raw assertion with timestamps.
- Service-account lineage: our inventory links service accounts to creation origin, last-used timestamp, owner (team), and current role bindings. We'll include a column for whether the account has multi-role privileges.

Ben — can you pull the SCIM delta export (last 90 days, CSV) and the service-account matrix? Jordan — please prepare the SAML samples and redact.

We'll aim to have a Drive folder and share link by Thu EOD (2026-10-08). If the auditor insists on separate signed attestations, let us know and we can prepare a short attestation PDF.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Security & Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Rosen <tim.rosen@medbridge.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SCIM lifecycle + service-account lineage for SOC2 pack

Adding status and data notes:

- Attached (internal staging): scim_delta_export_20261005.csv — columns: event_time, user_id, email_hash, action(add|modify|deprovision), source(scim_sync|ui|api), actor_id, attributes_changed. We flagged ~12 deprov events that originated from manual HR offboarding; will annotate with HR ticket ids.
- Service account matrix (service_account_lineage_matrix.xlsx) draft completed. There are 7 service accounts without an explicit owner in the directory; I've listed last-touch audit ids and an action column (ownership-claim-required).
- Note: one legacy sync connector created shadow-role bindings during a schema migration (2026-08-22) — Jordan, will you add a short blurb in the narrative describing the remediation we applied (role-prune run + annotation).

I will upload the staging files to the shared Drive link for Stephanie to redact and finalize.

-Ben
Ben Carter
IAM & Provisioning Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments: scim_delta_export_20261005.csv (CSV stub), service_account_lineage_matrix.xlsx (XLSX stub)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Tim Rosen <tim.rosen@medbridge.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 8 Oct 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SCIM lifecycle + service-account lineage for SOC2 pack

Tim — sharing the final package link and short narrative below. Stephanie signed off on redactions.

Drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/medbridge/iam-pack-20261006
Files included:
- scim_delta_export_20261005.csv (CSV) — contains 90-day delta rows; redacted email_hash instead of raw emails; has HR ticket references for manual deprovisions.
- saml_assertion_samples_anon.txt (TXT) — six anonymized assertion samples with assertion-id and timestamp; subject identifiers replaced with stable pseudonyms.
- service_account_lineage_matrix.xlsx (XLSX) — full mapping, owner column; 7 accounts flagged as "claim required" with recommended owner suggestions.
- readme_iam_pack_20261006.md (MD) — brief narrative: scope, export method, known gaps, remediation steps completed (role prune run on 2026-09-01, SCIM reconciliation job details).

Short summary for auditor:
- Export method: SCIM deltas exported from provisioning pipeline (immutable audit log) and cross-checked against sync logs.
- Gaps: 7 service accounts without an owner; these are scheduled for manual review during the Oct security sprint.
- Assertion samples: redacted to remove PII; retained original timestamps and authentication flow type.

If you or the auditor want me to generate a CSV of assertion timestamps only (for correlation with SSO logs), say the word and I will add it.

Thanks — Jordan Blake
Product Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

Forwarded-For-Auditor: Compliance Auditor <auditor@compliancefirm.io>
